# Configuration Management Standards

This directory contains standards for managing application configuration, secrets, and environment-specific settings.
page_texts.4:
[standards/application/configuration/README.md#std-app-cfg-001-configuration-management]

### STD-APP-CFG-001: Configuration Management

Standards for managing application configuration including externalized configuration, environment variables, secrets management, feature flags, and configuration validation.
page_texts.5:
[standards/application/configuration/README.md#purpose]

## Purpose

These standards ensure:
- Secure management of application configuration
- Separation of configuration from code
- Environment-specific configuration handling
- Secrets protection and rotation
- Auditable configuration changes
